verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All four clauses are stated; the rewriting is again only E = √(2X)·(angular field), so E_r/E = referenceAngular/activatedAngular, together with the (4.20) definitions being spelled out as `stockProjection p q t = p + q t` and `stockCross p q t = q - p t`. The t_s identity is `shearSlope_eq` term for term: (p_{2,r}/p_{1,r})·(E_r/E), with the common κ already cancelled (actualP1 = κ p_{1,r} and actualP2 = κ p_{2,r}·E_r/E, so the ratio has no κ) — the paper's 'the common κ cancels from the ratio t_s = -b_s/a'. The other three are the three conjuncts of `actual_comparisons`, with C·y·activation T κ y for O(y e_a): |P_c - v_r| (v_r = referenceSize), |v_s - κ v_r| (κ = damping T κ y), |J_c|. The constant C is produced before T and κ are quantified and is independent of both, which is the paper's 'No inverse power of κ₀ enters these error constants'; `shearSize_error` additionally gives v_s - κ v_r in closed form. Sign conventions agree: the paper's s = (a, -b_s) with b_s = 2 D_X U / E makes -b_s = X n_s/E, which is Lean's actualP2, so shearSlope = actualP2/actualP1 = -b_s/a = t_s.
